{{Quote|I think he's got a problem with his gearbox. It's just gone fifty meters into the air.|Niner after blowing up the Bothan's repulsortruck|<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''[[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]]''' was a [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Bothan, along with his [[Human/Legends|Human]] companions [[Forrie]] and [[Kimm]], was trying to steal [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] on a freighter park located on [[Quadrant G-80]]. Kimm and Forrie boarded the freighter ''[[Cornucopia]]'' in an attempt to steal it, not knowing that six [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]]s were aboard along with an [[Imperial commando/Legends|Imperial commando]] and the freighter's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Both Kimm and Forrie were instantly [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the commando [[Niner Skirata|Niner]] and Null ARC [[Ordo Skirata]]. When the Bothan, who was serving as the lookout for the group, lost his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] connection with the two, he began to worry and left in their escape vehicle. He died when Niner blew his [[Speeder truck/Legends|repulsortruck]] with a [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]].<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st" />
